title: Writing / Style / Capitalize
slide_intent: Distinguish named offerings and features from ordinary nouns so readers can recognize specific parts of the product.
strategic_value: A grouped naming chart can help Duolingo maintain recognizable labels across interface instructions and communications.
demonstration: Seven groups list capitalized features, achievements, purchased items, add-ons, specific levels, products and UI page titles, with usage examples.
practical_value: Check whether a term names a specific feature or item before capitalizing it.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Capitalize heading and rule for Duolingo-specific names at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the seven named categories at right, pairing checked names with example sentences where supplied.

reference_purposes.Application: Grouped names and example sentences show capitalization in context.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source calls for capitals on named features, achievements, purchased items, add-ons, specific levels, products and page titles as they appear in the UI.

ingredient.name: Capitalized product names
ingredient.role: Identify specific named parts of the offer.
ingredient.application: Capitalize named features, achievements, purchased items, add-ons, specific levels, products and UI page titles as listed.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. The chart includes retired product and feature names; it is not a current inventory.
